mapping_method: Draft creation from the exact frozen v13 133-question bank/key/map, the creator's own complete review-08 reports, all 24 reported scope-only corrections and the complete 14 surviving proposals in their report order. Independent unasked key background is separated from required facts. Every literal question is retained in its entry. Existing keys are not extended or edited. The creator does not decide a final semantic PASS.
grading_scope: Judge all actually requested material facts using equivalent wording and implied actors in context. A fixed key may include explanatory background; key_context_not_required is not an additional answer requirement or tested source coverage. A response need not recite stipulated givens or a counting guard if its answer already respects them.

creator_provenance.creator_context: This is the reviewer who authored review-08 and is now explicitly authorized to compile its proposals and apply its reported scope corrections. This creator is not the new final independent validator.
creator_provenance.model_provenance: No new model identity claim or independent validation is inferred from this compilation turn; creator is the already-assigned scope_and_coverage_08 agent.
creator_provenance.next_gate: Root reviews all 14 proposals and the complete corrected draft, freezes a final benchmark/map, then dispatches a NEW fresh source-only Sol/high/none scope-and-coverage validator.

root_promotion.change: Promoted complete source-only draft; additionally moved Q37 hand destination to context before testing; no existing questions or fixed keys changed.

questions.question: For two Spirits, how are the Fear pool/deck and Invader deck prepared, what initial Blight pool is used with and without a Blight Card, and what final Invader action completes setup?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: For two Spirits, how are the Fear pool/deck and Invader deck prepared, what initial Blight pool is used with and without a Blight Card, and what final Invader action completes setup?
required_facts: Two Spirits use 8 Fear markers.
Shuffle and use 9 Fear cards in three groups of 3 separated by Terror II/III.
Prepare 3 random Stage I above 4 Stage II above 5 Stage III, removing one unseen card of each stage.
Initial Healthy pool is 5; initial no-card pool is 11, including exactly one setup bonus.
Finish setup with a normal Explore and leave that card face-up in Build.

key_context_not_required.fact: Ravage is initially empty.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: Helpful initial-board context; the requested final setup action is Explore and its placement.

questions.question: A Spirit chooses Growth with two Add Presence actions. May the second placement use the first as its range origin? Which Presence-track disks may be taken, and how do uncovered Energy/Card Plays numbers combine?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: A Spirit chooses Growth with two Add Presence actions. May the second placement use the first as its range origin? Which Presence-track disks may be taken, and how do uncovered Energy/Card Plays numbers combine?
required_facts: Resolve the two placement actions in chosen order; the first new Presence may originate the second.
Take the leftmost remaining disk of either selected track for each placement.
Only the highest uncovered Energy and Card Plays numbers apply; do not add numbers.

questions.question: A Spirit has no Presence on its tracks but has Presence on the island and some destroyed disks. How can an Add Presence instruction be resolved, where is range measured, and can destroyed disks be used?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: A Spirit has no Presence on its tracks but has Presence on the island and some destroyed disks. How can an Add Presence instruction be resolved, where is range measured, and can destroyed disks be used?
required_facts: With tracks empty, reposition one of that Spirit's island Presence.
Measure the legal destination from existing island Presence, including the disk about to be repositioned, before picking a disk up.
Any of its island disks may supply the placement.
Destroyed disks cannot supply ordinary Add Presence without explicit permission.

questions.question: When are Fast and Slow Power Cards paid for and their Elements gained? Can promised Fast-phase Energy pay for the Spirit-phase cards, and do unspent Energy or unused Card Plays carry over?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: When are Fast and Slow Power Cards paid for and their Elements gained? Can promised Fast-phase Energy pay for the Spirit-phase cards, and do unspent Energy or unused Card Plays carry over?
required_facts: Play and pay for both Fast and Slow cards during Spirit Phase.
Their Elements become available immediately on play/payment.
Fast-phase Energy arrives too late to pay these normal Spirit-phase costs.
Energy carries over; unused Card Plays do not.

questions.question: May a Fast Power wait until Slow, may Powers interrupt each other, and when must a Slow Power’s target be selected?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: May a Fast Power wait until Slow, may Powers interrupt each other, and when must a Slow Power’s target be selected?
required_facts: Fast Powers must resolve in Fast or be foregone; they cannot wait until Slow.
Finish one Power before another; Powers cannot interrupt one another.
Choose a Slow Power's target when it is used in Slow, using the then-current position and restrictions.

key_context_not_required.fact: Players may choose the sequence of different Powers within the appropriate phase.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: Whether Powers may interrupt each other asks non-interruption, not the independent permission to choose the sequence of different Powers.

questions.question: In a Ravage a land has one Town, one Explorer and two undamaged Dahan, with no Defend or prior Blight. Resolve damage to land, Dahan, surviving counterattack and resulting Fear if the players destroy the Town.

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: In a Ravage a land has one Town, one Explorer and two undamaged Dahan, with no Defend or prior Blight. Resolve damage to land, Dahan, surviving counterattack and resulting Fear if the players destroy the Town.
required_facts: Town plus Explorer deal 3 Damage simultaneously to land and Dahan.
Add one Blight to the previously unblighted land.
Destroy one Dahan efficiently and mark 1 Damage on the survivor.
The surviving Dahan still deals 2 counterattack Damage.
Destroying the chosen Town generates 1 Fear.

key_context_not_required.fact: Partial Dahan Damage clears at Time Passes.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The question ends with this Ravage and resulting Fear, not end-of-turn healing.

questions.question: Compare a Ravage reduced to zero Damage by Defend with a Ravage skipped entirely. Do Dahan fight back in each, and does Spirit Presence counterattack?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Compare a Ravage reduced to zero Damage by Defend with a Ravage skipped entirely. Do Dahan fight back in each, and does Spirit Presence counterattack?
required_facts: Zero Invader Damage after Defend still permits surviving Dahan to counterattack.
Skipping the Ravage entirely gives no Dahan counterattack.
Spirit Presence does not counterattack.

key_context_not_required.fact: Each surviving Dahan ordinarily counterattacks for 2 Damage.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The prompt asks whether Dahan fight back under zero Damage versus a skipped Ravage. It does not ask their Damage amount.

questions.question: During Build, what is added to lands containing only Explorers, equal numbers of Towns and Cities, more Towns than Cities, or no Invaders? Are Towns upgraded?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: During Build, what is added to lands containing only Explorers, equal numbers of Towns and Cities, more Towns than Cities, or no Invaders? Are Towns upgraded?
required_facts: Only Explorers: add one Town.
Equal Town and City counts: add one Town.
More Towns than Cities: add one City.
No Invaders: no Build.
Build adds new supply pieces and does not upgrade/remove a Town.

questions.question: Which matching lands Explore, how many Explorers are added if there are multiple sources, do Explorers themselves provide a source, and what happens if no Invader Card can be drawn?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Which matching lands Explore, how many Explorers are added if there are multiple sources, do Explorers themselves provide a source, and what happens if no Invader Card can be drawn?
required_facts: Explore matching lands containing a Town/City or adjacent to a Town/City/Ocean.
Add one Explorer from supply per eligible land regardless of source count.
Explorers do not provide Explore sources.
Needing to draw from an empty Invader deck loses; drawing its last existing card alone does not.

questions.question: After Explore, where do the Invader cards go? How are a Stage III two-terrain card and a Stage II flag handled without an Adversary?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: After Explore, where do the Invader cards go? How are a Stage III two-terrain card and a Stage II flag handled without an Adversary?
required_facts: Discard old Ravage; move Build to Ravage and the newly explored card to Build.
Stage III affects both terrains under ordinary eligibility restrictions.
Ignore Stage II flag/Escalation without an Adversary.

questions.question: In a two-Spirit game with 7 of 8 Fear markers already generated, an effect generates 3 Fear and earning a card exposes Terror II. Explain marker handling, new Terror timing, and when the card is revealed/resolved.

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: In a two-Spirit game with 7 of 8 Fear markers already generated, an effect generates 3 Fear and earning a card exposes Terror II. Explain marker handling, new Terror timing, and when the card is revealed/resolved.
required_facts: The eighth Fear marker earns the top card face-down, then reset all 8 markers.
The remaining 2 generated Fear go toward the next card.
Exposed Terror II takes effect immediately.
Do not reveal the earned card until Fear resolution; resolve it at the then-current Terror level.

key_context_not_required.fact: Outcome check occurs at action-tree end.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The prompt asks marker handling, Terror timing and Fear-card reveal/resolution, not a victory/defeat check.

key_context_not_required.fact: An initial stack of earned Fear cards is resolved in earned order.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The given effect earns one card. The prompt asks its reveal/resolution time and Terror level, not the ordering of an initial multi-card earned stack.

questions.question: A Fear card resolved in the Fear step earns another Fear card and exposes a higher Terror Level. When is that new card resolved, at which level do subsequent cards resolve, and do “each player” choices require that player’s own Presence?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: A Fear card resolved in the Fear step earns another Fear card and exposes a higher Terror Level. When is that new card resolved, at which level do subsequent cards resolve, and do “each player” choices require that player’s own Presence?
required_facts: Put a newly earned Fear card at the bottom of the resolving stack and resolve it in the same Fear step.
Subsequent cards resolve only at the newly current Terror Level.
Each-player choices have no default requirement for that player's own Presence or Range; obey the card's restrictions.

key_context_not_required.fact: Generic Presence/Sacred Site conditions may use any Spirit unless individualized.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The actual prompt asks whether each-player choices require that player own Presence; the explicit individualized-site contrast is separately asked by Q51.

key_context_not_required.fact: Each player completes their own Fear-card instructions before the next player.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The each-player subquestion asks whether own Presence is required. It does not ask execution interleaving between players.

questions.question: A land with existing Blight has two Presence from Spirit A and one from Spirit B. One new Blight is added after setup. Describe Presence losses, cascade choices and what happens if the cascade enters another already-Blighted land.

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: A land with existing Blight has two Presence from Spirit A and one from Spirit B. One new Blight is added after setup. Describe Presence losses, cascade choices and what happens if the cascade enters another already-Blighted land.
required_facts: Destroy one Presence from A and one from B; put them beside the island, not back on tracks.
Add the original Blight and cascade one additional Blight to one chosen adjacent land.
If that land already had Blight, destroy one Presence of each Spirit present and cascade onward again.
Existing Blight quantity does not multiply the outgoing cascade.

questions.question: Where does setup Blight come from versus Blight added during play? When a Healthy card empties how is its new pool obtained, does the setup +1 repeat, and can removing Blight make it Healthy again?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Where does setup Blight come from versus Blight added during play? When a Healthy card empties how is its new pool obtained, does the setup +1 repeat, and can removing Blight make it Healthy again?
required_facts: Setup island Blight comes from the box; play Blight comes from the card/board pool.
On Healthy pool exhaustion flip and follow the reverse instructions, adding its printed new per-player pool from the box.
The setup +1 does not repeat on a flip.
Removing Blight never flips a Blighted card back to Healthy.

key_context_not_required.fact: Setup Blight does not cascade or destroy Presence.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The setup part asks where its Blight comes from, not setup Blight consequences.

key_context_not_required.fact: Removed island Blight returns to the currently face-up Blight Card or board pool.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The removal clause asks whether removal can make the card Healthy again. Neither it nor the setup-versus-play source question asks the destination of removed Blight.

questions.question: Explain how Elements apply to multiple thresholds and multiple Powers. May an innate be used twice with twice the Elements, may its levels use different lands, and how does an “Instead” level work?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Explain how Elements apply to multiple thresholds and multiple Powers. May an innate be used twice with twice the Elements, may its levels use different lands, and how does an “Instead” level work?
required_facts: Elements are checked rather than spent and can meet multiple thresholds and Powers.
Extra Elements do not give another ordinary Innate use.
An Innate's levels belong to one Power and use one target.
An Instead level replaces previous levels' effects rather than adding to them.

key_context_not_required.fact: May pretend to have fewer Elements for the entire Power.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: It asks multiple thresholds/Powers, repeated use, multiple targets and Instead; the positive fewer-Elements permission is separately requested by Q123.

key_context_not_required.fact: Default printed instruction/threshold order as a separate fact.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: Q15 asks reuse, use count, targets and Instead, rather than the sequence of ordinary effects; preserve the required replacement meaning without requiring an extra order recital. Q27 and Q133 directly test timing.

questions.question: A legal target lacks pieces needed for one printed instruction. May the Power still be used? May the player choose individual unwanted instructions to skip, or forego the whole Power and recover its Energy?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: A legal target lacks pieces needed for one printed instruction. May the Power still be used? May the player choose individual unwanted instructions to skip, or forego the whole Power and recover its Energy?
required_facts: A legal target remains legal even if an effect instruction is impossible.
Do as much as possible: resolve possible instructions and skip impossible parts.
Do not cherry-pick possible mandatory instructions.
The Spirit may forego the whole Power but receives no Energy refund.

key_context_not_required.fact: Consistently choosing fewer Elements; played-card Elements remain.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: Neither Element-selection mechanics nor retained Elements is requested here; Q121 and Q123 ask them directly.

key_context_not_required.fact: Possible Power instructions are ordinarily resolved in printed order.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The asked issues are legal use with an impossible instruction, selective skipping, foregoing the whole Power and Energy refund. They do not request the independent top-to-bottom ordering rule.

questions.question: Explain gaining a new Minor or Major Power, including how many are drawn, where kept/unkept cards go, Major Forgetting options and the consequences of Forgetting a card already in play.

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Explain gaining a new Minor or Major Power, including how many are drawn, where kept/unkept cards go, Major Forgetting options and the consequences of Forgetting a card already in play.
required_facts: Choose Minor or Major and draw 4, reshuffling that deck's discard if needed.
Keep one in hand and put unkept cards in their deck's shared discard.
Gaining a Major requires Forgetting one owned card, including hand/discard/in-play/new Major options.
Forgotten Minor/Major goes to its deck discard; Unique goes under its panel.
Forgetting an in-play card removes its Elements and any unused use immediately.
Already resolved effects persist for their normal duration.

questions.question: How do Damage, Destroy, Remove and Replace differ for Fear and survival? Can Damage from separate normal Powers combine, does Damage normally hurt Dahan, and does replacement erase prior Damage?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: How do Damage, Destroy, Remove and Replace differ for Fear and survival? Can Damage from separate normal Powers combine, does Damage normally hurt Dahan, and does replacement erase prior Damage?
required_facts: Unqualified Power Damage normally hurts Invaders in the target land; it does not normally harm Dahan.
Damage from normal separate Powers can combine during the turn.
Damage reaching Health immediately destroys a piece; survivor Damage clears at Time Passes.
Destroying a Town/City causes 1/2 Fear in addition to explicit Fear.
Remove/Replace themselves generate no destruction Fear.
Replace retains prior Damage and can cause destruction if it meets the new piece's Health.

key_context_not_required.fact: An ordinary Power Damage budget may be distributed among Invaders in its target land as desired.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The comparison is explicitly for Fear and survival, followed by accumulation, Dahan recipients and retained replacement Damage. It never asks how freely a Damage budget can be split among different Invaders.

questions.question: Does increased Power Range extend Gather/Push distance, may multiple pieces come from/go to different adjacent lands, may pieces go into the Ocean normally, and may “up to” be zero?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Does increased Power Range extend Gather/Push distance, may multiple pieces come from/go to different adjacent lands, may pieces go into the Ocean normally, and may “up to” be zero?
required_facts: Range boosts do not change the adjacent-land distance of Gather/Push.
Gather brings pieces from adjacent land(s) into the target.
Push sends pieces from the target to adjacent land(s), allowing different destinations.
Multiple pieces may come from different source lands.
Ordinary movement cannot send them into Ocean/off-board.
Up to permits zero.

questions.question: State all four Terror victory conditions, the three standard defeat routes, and the result when a single Ravage loses a Spirit’s last Presence but surviving Dahan remove the final required Invader. Do you finish other lands first?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: State all four Terror victory conditions, the three standard defeat routes, and the result when a single Ravage loses a Spirit’s last Presence but surviving Dahan remove the final required Invader. Do you finish other lands first?
required_facts: Terror I needs no Invaders; II no Towns/Cities; III no Cities.
Earning the final Fear card exposes Victory and wins without resolving its text.
Standard defeat routes are exhausted Blight as instructed, any Spirit without island Presence, and needing to draw from an empty Invader deck.
Finish the single-land Ravage and its triggered actions before checking outcomes.
If that tree meets both win and loss conditions it is a sacrifice victory.
Do not finish later land Ravages before checking.

questions.question: What makes two lands adjacent, including across boards? Are all outside-edge lands Coastal, is Ocean normally a land, and can a land be adjacent to itself or within Range 1 of itself?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: What makes two lands adjacent, including across boards? Are all outside-edge lands Coastal, is Ocean normally a land, and can a land be adjacent to itself or within Range 1 of itself?
required_facts: Adjacent lands share a border or corner, including across boards.
Coastal means adjacent to printed Ocean; other outside cliffs do not count.
Ocean is normally not a land or in play.
A land is not adjacent to itself but is Range 0 of itself and within Range 1.

questions.question: How is a Spirit’s starting hand obtained, where is its setup Presence placed, what if multiple legal setup choices or two placement instructions name the same land, and is its later play confined to that board?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: How is a Spirit’s starting hand obtained, where is its setup Presence placed, what if multiple legal setup choices or two placement instructions name the same land, and is its later play confined to that board?
required_facts: Start with the Spirit's four Unique cards in hand.
Each Spirit starts on a different board and follows its back-panel setup.
Choose freely among equally legal setup choices.
Separate placement instructions may name the same land.
After setup Presence and Powers may operate on other boards.

questions.question: Does one Presence each from two Spirits form a Sacred Site? Does four Presence from one Spirit count as two sites, and what does “your land” mean?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Does one Presence each from two Spirits form a Sacred Site? Does four Presence from one Spirit count as two sites, and what does “your land” mean?
required_facts: One disk each from two Spirits does not ordinarily form a Sacred Site.
A Spirit normally needs at least two of its own disks.
Four of its disks in one land still form only one site.
Your land means a land with your Presence.

questions.question: A Growth option includes an impossible instruction and an explicit cost. Can it be selected, can possible instructions be skipped, and may one Spirit wait for another’s Growth result before choosing?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: A Growth option includes an impossible instruction and an explicit cost. Can it be selected, can possible instructions be skipped, and may one Spirit wait for another’s Growth result before choosing?
required_facts: An impossible non-cost Growth instruction does not prevent selecting that option.
Do all possible instructions; do not voluntarily skip mandatory possible parts.
An explicit Growth cost must be paid fully.
A Spirit may wait for another's Growth result.

key_context_not_required.fact: Instructions within a selected Growth option may be resolved in any order.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: It asks selection despite an impossible instruction, possible instructions being mandatory, paying the cost, and waiting for another Growth result. It does not ask either within-option free ordering or the full formal phase barrier/order.

key_context_not_required.fact: Each Spirit keeps its own Growth/Energy/play order; all Spirits finish the Spirit Phase before anyone begins resolving Fast Powers.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: It asks selection despite an impossible instruction, possible instructions being mandatory, paying the cost, and waiting for another Growth result. It does not ask either within-option free ordering or the full formal phase barrier/order.

questions.question: What cards does ordinary Reclaim return, and when and how often can a newly uncovered Reclaim One space be used?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: What cards does ordinary Reclaim return, and when and how often can a newly uncovered Reclaim One space be used?
required_facts: Ordinary Reclaim returns all personal-discard cards to hand, not in-play or forgotten cards.
Reclaim One returns one personal-discard card once per Spirit Phase at any time during that phase.
It is available the turn uncovered.

questions.question: When a track Element is revealed after Growth, when does it become usable? When may an Any track Element be chosen and changed, and what if an in-play card is Forgotten?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: When a track Element is revealed after Growth, when does it become usable? When may an Any track Element be chosen and changed, and what if an in-play card is Forgotten?
required_facts: A revealed track Element is usable immediately and remains available while uncovered.
Choose a passive Any at any time during the turn; once chosen it is fixed until next turn.
Forgetting an in-play card removes that card's Elements immediately.

questions.question: A Power’s earlier instruction uncovers an Element needed for a later threshold. Can that later threshold apply? What if Elements are lost instead, and can earlier resolved effects be revised?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: A Power’s earlier instruction uncovers an Element needed for a later threshold. Can that later threshold apply? What if Elements are lost instead, and can earlier resolved effects be revised?
required_facts: An Element gained earlier in a Power can satisfy a later threshold.
Losing Elements can prevent a later threshold.
Do not revise already resolved effects retroactively.

key_context_not_required.fact: Speed/Range/target modifications must be checked at selection, and or choice precedes branch resolution.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: No such modifier or or choice is in this question; it asks only later Element thresholds and retroactivity.

questions.question: Must a land at Range 0 contain your Presence? Can a numeric Range boost waive a Sacred Site origin, a target-terrain restriction or the text “one of your lands”?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Must a land at Range 0 contain your Presence? Can a numeric Range boost waive a Sacred Site origin, a target-terrain restriction or the text “one of your lands”?
required_facts: An ordinary Range 0 target contains your Presence.
A numeric Range increase does not waive a Sacred Site/origin restriction.
It does not waive terrain or other target contents restrictions, including one of your lands.

questions.question: May a legally targeted Power count as used if its instructions accomplish nothing? Does foregoing its text count as targeting it? Can an innate with only its own Speed/Range modification available be used?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: May a legally targeted Power count as used if its instructions accomplish nothing? Does foregoing its text count as targeting it? Can an innate with only its own Speed/Range modification available be used?
required_facts: A legal Power may count as used even if its attempted instructions change nothing.
It needs an instruction with potential to affect game state.
Foregoing its text is not using/targeting it.
Changing only its own Speed/Range does not make an Innate usable.

questions.question: A card adds a Town in Slow and says Invaders skip Build this turn. What remains next turn? At Time Passes where do played cards go, what happens to damaged survivors and reminder markers, and do track Elements vanish?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: A card adds a Town in Slow and says Invaders skip Build this turn. What remains next turn? At Time Passes where do played cards go, what happens to damaged survivors and reminder markers, and do track Elements vanish?
required_facts: The added Town stays next turn as a board change.
The turn's Build-skip effect expires at Time Passes.
Discard played cards to personal discard and clear card Elements.
Heal survivor Damage and remove temporary effects/reminder markers.
Uncovered track Elements remain.

questions.question: Do damaged Invaders and Dahan deal less Damage? If Defend 1 and Defend 2 both affect a land with total Invader Damage 4, what Damage reaches the land and Dahan?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Do damaged Invaders and Dahan deal less Damage? If Defend 1 and Defend 2 both affect a land with total Invader Damage 4, what Damage reaches the land and Dahan?
required_facts: Damaged Invaders and Dahan deal their full normal Damage.
Defend 1 and 2 stack to Defend 3.
Invader total 4 becomes 1 Damage to land and separately 1 Damage to Dahan.

key_context_not_required.fact: The resulting 1 Damage to the land adds no Blight.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The prompt asks the Damage reaching land and Dahan, not the subsequent Blight consequence. The complete numeric answer is 1 to each.

questions.question: If a Town is replaced by an Explorer while retaining 1 Damage, does the replacement itself cause Fear, does the Explorer survive, and why? Can reduced Health destroy a piece without new Damage?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: If a Town is replaced by an Explorer while retaining 1 Damage, does the replacement itself cause Fear, does the Explorer survive, and why? Can reduced Health destroy a piece without new Damage?
required_facts: Replacement itself generates no Fear.
The Explorer retains 1 Damage, meets its 1 Health and is destroyed.
Reduced Health can immediately destroy a piece without new Damage.

key_context_not_required.fact: Destroying the resulting Explorer gives no Fear.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: It asks whether replacement itself causes Fear, Explorer survival and reduced-Health destruction. It does not ask total Fear from the Explorer destruction.

questions.question: Do Dahan automatically attack when a Spirit damages or Pushing Invaders into their land, and can a Power’s unqualified Damage hit Dahan? Are Dahan and Invaders limited by the physical supply?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Do Dahan automatically attack when a Spirit damages or Pushing Invaders into their land, and can a Power’s unqualified Damage hit Dahan? Are Dahan and Invaders limited by the physical supply?
required_facts: Dahan do not automatically attack merely because a Power Damages or Pushes Invaders into their land.
Unqualified Power Damage affects Invaders; Dahan require explicit harmful text.
Invader and Dahan supplies are unlimited; use substitutes when needed.

key_context_not_required.fact: Dahan attack during their Ravage counterattack or when an explicit instruction causes them to attack.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The question asks whether damage or Push automatically causes Dahan attacks, plus recipients and supply limits. It does not request a catalogue of all circumstances that do allow attacks.

questions.question: Do increased Range and a large number of pieces let a single ordinary Power distribute its effects across multiple target lands? What does Push up to 3 Explorer/Town allow in terms of total pieces?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Do increased Range and a large number of pieces let a single ordinary Power distribute its effects across multiple target lands? What does Push up to 3 Explorer/Town allow in terms of total pieces?
required_facts: An ordinary Power has one target land regardless of Range or piece count.
Only explicit instructions can affect other lands, such as Push destinations.
Up to 3 Explorer/Town is a combined limit of 3 pieces of either/both types, not 3 each.

questions.question: If Gather 3 or Push 3 lacks “up to,” may the player move only one when three legal pieces are available? What if only two are available? Can unrestricted Move leave a piece in its current land?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: If Gather 3 or Push 3 lacks “up to,” may the player move only one when three legal pieces are available? What if only two are available? Can unrestricted Move leave a piece in its current land?
required_facts: Without up to, move the stated number if possible, so not only one when three are available.
If only two can legally be moved, move both.
Unrestricted Move may leave a piece in the same land and still counts as movement.

key_context_not_required.fact: Gather and Push require adjacent lands and cannot move a piece from a land to itself.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The final clause specifically asks about unrestricted Move. No clause asks whether Gather or Push may move to the same land. Their stated quantities in the earlier clauses concern how many must move.

questions.question: What is the difference between a Growth Move Presence arrow and Add Presence using an island disk? Can the latter pick up a disk outside the shown Range of the destination?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: What is the difference between a Growth Move Presence arrow and Add Presence using an island disk? Can the latter pick up a disk outside the shown Range of the destination?
required_facts: Growth Move Presence measures up to the indicated distance from that disk's current land.
Add Presence using an island disk first selects a destination measured from existing Presence.
It may then take an island disk from anywhere, even outside the shown destination Range.
Repositioning under Add is adding rather than a Move instruction.

questions.question: A Spirit Power directly and explicitly deals 2 Damage to Dahan; it does not cause a Ravage. Would Defend 3 reduce this Damage? Would Concealing Shadows prevent it? In the separate Ravage, Defend 3 reduces 2 Damage to zero for both land and Dahan, not negative Damage.

questions.question: Spirit A has an existing +2 bonus to its Power Ranges and uses Reaching Grasp, whose text grants target Spirit B +2 Range with all their Powers. required_facts: A's existing Range bonus does not increase Reaching Grasp's Range bonus grant; B gets +2, not +4.
B's Power-only bonus covers both Innates and Power Cards.
It does not extend ordinary Growth placement.

key_context_not_required.fact: Power Cards resolve after normal Growth.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The prompt asks the Power-only scope boundary; this timing justification is useful but not independently requested.

questions.question: For a Range arrow within a Power’s effect text, where is the origin for a land-targeting Power? Which Spirit’s Range bonuses apply, and if that internal arrow is Range 1 with A having +2 and B having no bonus, what Range can it reach from whose Presence? How does Blazing Renewal’s explicit measurement origin differ?

questions.question: A Spirit plays and pays for a Power Card, then foregoes its entire text because it has no legal target or the Spirit chooses not to use it. Normally discard it at Time Passes and lose its Elements then.

questions.question: Two separate Ravages occur in the same land before Time Passes. How much Damage reaches land and Dahan each time? Do the two 1-Damage land results combine into Blight, and what happens to that Dahan on the second Ravage?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Two separate Ravages occur in the same land before Time Passes. Each would deal 4 Damage before the land’s Defend 3; assume that pre-Defend total stays 4, and one Dahan starts healthy. Is Defend expended on the first Ravage? How much Damage reaches land and Dahan each time? Do the two 1-Damage land results combine into Blight, and what happens to that Dahan on the second Ravage?
required_facts: Defend 3 applies to each Ravage for the whole turn and is not expended.
Each of the two Ravages deals 1 Damage to land and separately 1 to the Dahan.
Sub-2 land Damage is ignored per occurrence; the two instances do not accumulate into Blight.
Dahan Damage does persist: the second 1 reaches 2 Health and destroys it before a second counterattack.

questions.question: A Power has a lower threshold requiring 2 Water and a higher threshold requiring 3 Water. Its Spirit has 3 Water. May the Spirit resolve that Power as if it had only 2 Water, getting the lower threshold but not the higher one? May another Power still check the Spirit's actual 3 Water later this turn? Assume no instruction gains or loses Elements.
required_facts: It may consistently assume only 2 Water for that entire Power and resolve the lower but not higher threshold.
It must resolve every effect met by that assumed Element set, rather than selecting individual instructions.
This does not spend/remove the actual Water; another Power may still check actual 3 Water later.

questions.question: A Spirit has several separate Growth options and no instruction allowing more than one choice. During one Spirit Phase, may it combine the Energy action from one option with the Add Presence action from a different option, or must it choose a single entire option?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: A Spirit has several separate Growth options and no instruction allowing more than one choice. During one Spirit Phase, may it combine the Energy action from one option with the Add Presence action from a different option, or must it choose a single entire option?
required_facts: Without permission for more, choose one whole Growth option.
Do not combine actions from different options or choose multiple options.
Perform all possible instructions in the selected option.

key_context_not_required.fact: Chosen option instructions may be performed in any order.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: It asks whether actions from separate options can be combined, not ordering within the selected option.

questions.question: An ordinary land-targeting Power has printed Range 1, Target ANY and no special origin requirement. Your Presence is in land A, and land B is adjacent to A. requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: An ordinary land-targeting Power has printed Range 1, Target ANY and no special origin requirement. Your Presence is in land A, and land B is adjacent to A. Assuming all other restrictions are met, may you target A as well as B, or must the target be exactly one land away from your Presence?
required_facts: Both the Presence land A and adjacent B are legal targets.
Printed Range 1 is a maximum and permits Range 0; it is not an exact required distance.

questions.question: Spirit A uses Powerstorm on Bringer of Dreams and Nightmares. Afterwards Bringer uses Call on Midnight’s Dream in a legal land with Dahan, gains a Fast Major Power, Forgets Call on Midnight’s Dream for the Major gain, and uses its conditional permission to play the new Major immediately. Bringer then uses that new Major normally. Assume sufficient Energy, valid targets, and no other restrictions. May Bringer spend the previously granted Powerstorm Repeat on this new Major even though it was not in play when Powerstorm resolved?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Spirit A uses Powerstorm on Bringer of Dreams and Nightmares. Afterwards Bringer uses Call on Midnight’s Dream in a legal land with Dahan, gains a Fast Major Power, Forgets Call on Midnight’s Dream for the Major gain, and uses its conditional permission to play the new Major immediately. Bringer then uses that new Major normally. Assume sufficient Energy, valid targets, and no other restrictions. May Bringer spend the previously granted Powerstorm Repeat on this new Major even though it was not in play when Powerstorm resolved?
required_facts: Yes: Powerstorm's once-this-turn Repeat permission belongs to the Spirit and is not a snapshot of cards in play at grant time.
The newly played Major is eligible even though it entered play after Powerstorm resolved.

key_context_not_required.fact: Bringer can pay the cost and Repeat at current Speed; forgetting the old Unique does not remove the new Major.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: Sufficient Energy/validity are stipulated; the asked issue is eligibility of a card entering play after grant, not Repeat payment/timing or card identity.

questions.question: In a standard core game a land is already crowded with Invaders, Dahan, and Spirit Presence. Can a general per-land stacking limit prevent an otherwise legal Build, Gather, or Presence placement there? Do any of those three types of piece have such a default cap?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: In a standard core game a land is already crowded with Invaders, Dahan, and Spirit Presence. Can a general per-land stacking limit prevent an otherwise legal Build, Gather, or Presence placement there? Do any of those three types of piece have such a default cap?
required_facts: There is no default per-land stacking cap for Invaders, Dahan or Presence.
Crowding alone does not prevent the otherwise legal Build, Gather or Presence placement.

key_context_not_required.fact: Specific actions still obey instructions; large Presence stack remains one Sacred Site.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: Otherwise legal actions are stipulated, and no Sacred Site count is asked.

questions.question: Bringer uses Call on Midnight’s Dream in a legal target land containing both Dahan and Invaders. May Bringer first draw and inspect the four Major Power Cards from the first option, then decide to take the other option’s 2 Fear instead, or must the ~or~ option be chosen before either option begins resolving?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Bringer uses Call on Midnight’s Dream in a legal target land containing both Dahan and Invaders. May Bringer first draw and inspect the four Major Power Cards from the first option, then decide to take the other option’s 2 Fear instead, or must the ~or~ option be chosen before either option begins resolving?
required_facts: Choose the or branch before resolving either option.
Drawing/inspecting the Major cards already begins the Major-gain option.
It cannot inspect that draw and then switch to the 2 Fear option.

key_context_not_required.fact: Major gain is draw-four/keep-one with ordinary Forgetting.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The issue is commitment before inspection, not the complete Major gain procedure; Q17 requests that procedure.

questions.question: What is the required order of an individual Spirit's Growth, normal track Energy gain, and actual playing/paying for Power Cards? May the Spirit take its normal Energy income before finishing Growth or actually play/pay before Growth? If Growth uncovers a higher Energy number, is that number used for normal income in this same Spirit Phase?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Required individual three-step order
required_facts: Complete Growth, then gain normal track Energy, then actually play/pay Power Cards.

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: May normal income or actual play/pay precede Growth?
required_facts: Normal income may not be taken before finishing Growth.
Actual normal card play/payment may not precede Growth.

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Higher Energy revealed by Growth
required_facts: The immediately following normal income step uses the newly uncovered highest number in this same Spirit Phase.

key_context_not_required.fact: Earlier private planning is allowed.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The prompt expressly asks formal actual play/pay, not private planning.

questions.question: A Spirit still has Presence disks on its Presence tracks. When resolving an ordinary Add Presence instruction, may it choose to reposition one of its Presence already on the island instead of taking a track disk, or is repositioning permitted only after its tracks are empty?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Reposition while track disks remain
required_facts: Yes: ordinary Add Presence may use an own island disk instead of a track disk even before tracks are empty.

key_context_not_required.fact: How to choose destination/origin and that no track space is uncovered.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: This question asks availability before tracks empty; Q03/Q36 cover the substitution procedure.

questions.question: Dread Apparitions has already resolved in a land. A normal Spirit Power there generates 1 printed Fear and destroys one Town, generating another 1 Fear. Which of those Fear sources count for Dread Apparitions, and counting only this later Power’s Fear, how much additional Defend does it add? Separately, Bringer’s Power there generates exactly 2 Fear from To Dream a Thousand Deaths pretend-destroying a Town and no other Fear. Does that Fear count, and how much additional Defend is added?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Fear-source eligibility and increment from normal Power
required_facts: Printed Power Fear counts.

The later normal Power adds Defend1, not2, excluding earlier Defend.

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Bringer nightmare Fear
required_facts: The2 Fear from To Dream a Thousand Deaths counts.
That Fear adds Defend2.

questions.question: Ocean uses Tidal Boon on another Spirit, and that Spirit uses this Power’s Push to send a Dahan into Ocean’s active Ocean. May Ocean instead move that Dahan to a nonadjacent Coastal land rather than Drowning it? Who chooses, and is taking that alternative mandatory?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Rescue destination
required_facts: Yes: Dahan pushed to Ocean by this use can be moved to any Coastal land, including a nonadjacent one.

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Who chooses and is it mandatory?
required_facts: Ocean, the Spirit using Tidal Boon, chooses whether to take the alternative.
The alternative is optional, not mandatory.

key_context_not_required.fact: If declined, normal Drowning applies.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: Useful consequence but the prompt asks optionality rather than separately asking the declined result.

key_context_not_required.fact: Only this use’s Push qualifies, not later unrelated Pushes.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The prompt explicitly stipulates this Power’s Push; Q68 asks the later unrelated branch.

questions.question: Wrap in Wings of Sunlight meets its threshold. Its target land initially has no Dahan, but Dahan are available in adjacent lands. requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Wrap First Gather timing and consequences
required_facts: The met threshold’s First Gather occurs before the base Move.
Dahan gathered that way may be moved by the base effect, permitting Defend in the destination when at least one moves.

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Dissolve timing
required_facts: The threshold’s Invader-on-Invader Damage resolves before the Explorer Push.

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Printed-position exception
required_facts: Explicit First/Before timing overrides the default printed position.

key_context_not_required.fact: Exact Defend5 quantity.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: This prompt asks whether the destination can be Defended, not the numerical Defend amount.

key_context_not_required.fact: Dissolve Damage follows preceding replacements.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The requested comparison is Damage before versus after Push; prior replacements are contextual.

key_context_not_required.fact: This remains one Power use.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: No use-count question is asked here.

questions.question: List the five phases of an ordinary turn in order. If one Spirit has finished playing and paying while another is still choosing Growth, may the first begin resolving a Fast Power? Within the Fast Power Phase, must Powers follow player order, or may players choose their sequence?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: List the five phases of an ordinary turn in order. If one Spirit has finished playing and paying while another is still choosing Growth, may the first begin resolving a Fast Power? Within the Fast Power Phase, must Powers follow player order, or may players choose their sequence?
required_facts: The ordinary five-phase order is Spirit Phase, Fast Power Phase, Invader Phase, Slow Power Phase, then Time Passes.
No Spirit may begin resolving Fast Powers until all Spirits have completed the Spirit Phase.
Within the Fast Power Phase players may choose the sequence of Powers; no fixed player order is required.

key_context_not_required.fact: Powers must complete one at a time without interrupting another.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The new question asks sequence choice, not interruption; Q05 directly asks that rule.

questions.question: After a Spirit has followed its back-panel island setup, where are its remaining Presence disks put? Are the leftmost solid-circle Energy and Card Plays numbers covered?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: After a Spirit has followed its back-panel island setup, where are its remaining Presence disks put? Are the leftmost solid-circle Energy and Card Plays numbers covered?
required_facts: After island setup, put remaining Presence on the dashed circles of the Spirit panel's Presence tracks.
Leave the leftmost solid-circle Energy and Card Plays numbers uncovered.

key_context_not_required.fact: Flip the Spirit panel from its setup side to its playing side before covering the tracks.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The prompt asks the locations and uncovered spaces, not a separate recital of the physical panel flip.

questions.question: When using a beginner Spirit’s Power Progression, what must be done during setup with the Minor and Major cards listed on that Progression? Should they stay in the shared shuffled decks to be drawn normally by other gains?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: When using a beginner Spirit’s Power Progression, what must be done during setup with the Minor and Major cards listed on that Progression? Should they stay in the shared shuffled decks to be drawn normally by other gains?
required_facts: During Power Progression setup, set aside all listed Minor and Major Power Cards.
Those reserved cards do not remain in the shared shuffled decks for ordinary draws.

key_context_not_required.fact: Later gains take the next reserved Progression card.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The new question asks setup reservation; Q56 directly asks later gains.

questions.question: Do the normal cascade and one-Presence-per-Spirit destruction rules apply to Blight placed during setup, or only to Blight added after setup?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Do the normal cascade and one-Presence-per-Spirit destruction rules apply to Blight placed during setup, or only to Blight added after setup?
required_facts: Setup Blight does not trigger the normal cascade rule.
Setup Blight does not destroy Presence; those normal adverse addition consequences apply after setup.

questions.question: In the first ordinary turn after standard setup, the Ravage Action Space has no Invader Card. Do Invaders Ravage anyway or draw a card for Ravage, or is that action omitted? What is the general rule for an empty Invader Action Space?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: In the first ordinary turn after standard setup, the Ravage Action Space has no Invader Card. Do Invaders Ravage anyway or draw a card for Ravage, or is that action omitted? What is the general rule for an empty Invader Action Space?
required_facts: No Invader action is taken for a space with no Invader Card.
The first ordinary empty Ravage space therefore causes no Ravage: do not draw a Ravage card or invent a terrain for it.

key_context_not_required.fact: Standard setup leaves the initial Explore card in Build.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: Useful justification already asked by Q01; the new question gives the empty Ravage space.

questions.question: Three Fear Cards were earned in a known order. During the Fear step, may players inspect all three before resolving the first? In which order are they resolved, and where does each card go once resolved?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Three Fear Cards were earned in a known order. During the Fear step, may players inspect all three before resolving the first? In which order are they resolved, and where does each card go once resolved?
required_facts: Do not inspect all earned Fear Cards before resolving the first; reveal/read them one at a time without looking ahead.
Resolve the initial earned stack in the order the cards were earned.
After resolving a Fear Card, put it in the Fear Discard space.

questions.question: A normal Power deals 3 Damage in a land with a healthy Town and City. Must players finish destroying one chosen Invader before assigning Damage to the other, or may they assign 1 to the Town and 2 to the City so both survive?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: A normal Power deals 3 Damage in a land with a healthy Town and City. Must players finish destroying one chosen Invader before assigning Damage to the other, or may they assign 1 to the Town and 2 to the City so both survive?
required_facts: Ordinary Power Damage may be freely divided among Invaders in the target land.
Players need not finish destroying one Invader before assigning Damage to another.
The proposed allocation of 1 Damage to the healthy Town and 2 to the healthy City is legal and leaves both as damaged survivors.

key_context_not_required.fact: Ordinary Damage allocation has no Explorer-first requirement.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: No Explorer is supplied in this question; the asked choice is whether one Town/City must be finished before damaging the other.

questions.question: An instruction explicitly downgrades two Invaders simultaneously. May one City be selected twice, first becoming a Town and then an Explorer, or must the pieces be selected before either replacement? Contrast two separate players’ legal Trade Suffers III actions.

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: An instruction explicitly downgrades two Invaders simultaneously. May one City be selected twice, first becoming a Town and then an Explorer, or must the pieces be selected before either replacement? Contrast two separate players’ legal Trade Suffers III actions.
required_facts: A single simultaneous replacement instruction selects all pieces before replacing any of them.
It cannot select one original City twice to chain City-to-Town-to-Explorer within that instruction; replace the selected pieces simultaneously.
Two separate players' legal Trade Suffers III actions may successively downgrade the same resulting piece.

key_context_not_required.fact: Separate completed instructions as well as separate actions may replace the resulting piece again.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The explicit contrast asks separate players' actions; the broader separate-instruction example is supporting context.

questions.question: Assume two Ravage Cards will be resolved in sequence. A land matching the second card is empty when the Ravage step begins, but a triggered effect during the first card moves an Invader there before the second card begins. Does that land Ravage from the second card, or was eligibility locked for the whole step?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Assume two Ravage Cards will be resolved in sequence. A land matching the second card is empty when the Ravage step begins, but a triggered effect during the first card moves an Invader there before the second card begins. Does that land Ravage from the second card, or was eligibility locked for the whole step?
required_facts: The newly occupied matching land Ravages from the second Ravage Card in the stated case.
Determine a fresh affected-land list before resolving each card; eligibility is not locked once for the entire Ravage step.

questions.question: When Ocean exchanges already Drowned Invaders for Energy, does it value their modified current Health, or their printed Health? Do temporary and permanent Health modifiers change that exchange value?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: When Ocean exchanges already Drowned Invaders for Energy, does it value their modified current Health, or their printed Health? Do temporary and permanent Health modifiers change that exchange value?
required_facts: Ocean uses printed, unmodified Invader Health for the Drowned-Invader Energy exchange.
Ignore all Health modifiers for that valuation, including both temporary and permanent modifiers.

questions.question: Dissolve the Bonds of Kinship must Push three Explorers, and three distinct adjacent legal destination lands are available. May all three be sent to one land, or must they be split? If only two legal destination lands are available, what distribution restriction remains?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Dissolve the Bonds of Kinship must Push three Explorers, and three distinct adjacent legal destination lands are available. May all three be sent to one land, or must they be split? If only two legal destination lands are available, what distribution restriction remains?
required_facts: Dissolve requires its Explorer Push to use as many different legal destination lands as possible.
With three pushed Explorers and three legal destination lands, send one Explorer to each of those three lands.
With only two legal destination lands, use both: one receives two Explorers and the other one.

questions.question: Words of Warning has resolved on a land that will Ravage. Do its Dahan deal their one Ravage attack simultaneously with the Invaders, or only surviving Dahan after Invader Damage? Can a Dahan destroyed by that same simultaneous Damage still contribute its Ravage Damage?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Words of Warning has resolved on a land that will Ravage. Do its Dahan deal their one Ravage attack simultaneously with the Invaders, or only surviving Dahan after Invader Damage? Can a Dahan destroyed by that same simultaneous Damage still contribute its Ravage Damage?
required_facts: Under Words of Warning the Dahan deal their Ravage Damage simultaneously with the Invaders, rather than only surviving Dahan attacking afterward.
A Dahan destroyed by that same simultaneous exchange still contributes its Ravage Damage.

key_context_not_required.fact: The Dahan receive no second later counterattack.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The prompt already supplies their one Ravage attack and asks its timing/simultaneously killed contributors; Q98 directly asks the no-extra-attack rule.

questions.question: Entwined Power’s target Spirit draws four cards for its gain and keeps one. For the using Spirit’s subsequent gain, does that Spirit draw a fresh set of four, or select from the three cards the target did not keep? In solo, are the two cards gained through this base effect selected from one initial draw or two?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Entwined Power’s target Spirit draws four cards for its gain and keeps one. For the using Spirit’s subsequent gain, does that Spirit draw a fresh set of four, or select from the three cards the target did not keep? In solo, are the two cards gained through this base effect selected from one initial draw or two?
required_facts: For Entwined's subsequent gain, the using Spirit selects one of the cards the target did not keep from the initial draw; it does not draw a fresh four.
In solo the two cards gained through this base effect come from the same initial draw of four, not two independent draws.

key_context_not_required.fact: Each Major actually gained still requires its own ordinary Forget.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The question asks the eligible draw cohort, not Major costs; Q17/Q39 ask those costs.

questions.question: When a Power removes Blight from the island, does the token go back to the box or to the currently face-up Blight Card/Invader Board pool? Does a Blighted Island card receive removed Blight too?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: When a Power removes Blight from the island, does the token go back to the box or to the currently face-up Blight Card/Invader Board pool? Does a Blighted Island card receive removed Blight too?
required_facts: Removed island Blight returns to the currently face-up Blight Card or board Blight pool, not to the box.
The currently face-up Blighted Island side also receives removed Blight.

key_context_not_required.fact: Returning Blight replenishes the active pool but never flips Blighted back to Healthy.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The new question asks the token destination and eligibility of the Blighted pool, not reversal to Healthy; Q14 asks that reversal question.
